listings.name: Bellagio Casino
listings.blurb: The crown jewel of the Strip — fountains, high-limit floors, legendary jackpots.
listings.description: The crown jewel of the Las Vegas Strip. From the iconic fountain shows to the 100,000 sq ft casino floor, this is where legends are made — and jackpots are won.

listings.name: Aria Resort & Casino
listings.blurb: The most sophisticated casino experience in Vegas — that high-limit slot room is unreal.
listings.description: Sleek, modern, and endlessly photogenic. Aria's high-limit slot room and Sky Suites set the standard for CityCenter luxury.
listings.tam_quote: The most sophisticated casino experience in Vegas. The high-limit slot room? Absolutely unreal vibes.

listings.name: MGM Grand Casino
listings.blurb: Insane dollar-slot promos and a summer pool complex — this week's must-visit.
listings.description: MGM Grand is running insane promotions on their dollar slots, plus their pool complex is now open for summer. Free resort credit for new loyalty sign-ups through the weekend.

listings.name: The Cosmopolitan
listings.blurb: Chandelier bar, chic floors, and the best people-watching on the Strip.
listings.description: Three stories of crystal at the Chandelier Bar, a buzzing casino floor, and some of the best dining in town. The Cosmo is where style meets play.

listings.name: Borgata Hotel Casino
listings.blurb: The East Coast's marquee casino — poker room, top-tier dining, boardwalk close.
listings.description: Atlantic City's flagship. A world-class poker room, celebrity-chef dining, and a spa that rivals anything in Vegas.

listings.name: Wicked Spoon at Cosmopolitan
listings.blurb: Vegas' most Instagrammable buffet — worth every penny of the splurge.
listings.description: Individually plated portions, a legendary dessert wall, and bone-marrow that people plan trips around. Vegas' most Instagrammable buffet.

listings.name: Bacchanal Buffet
listings.blurb: 500+ dishes at Caesars — the gold standard of Vegas buffets.
listings.description: Over 500 dishes across nine open kitchens at Caesars Palace. Crab legs, made-to-order everything, and the best buffet in Nevada 2025.

listings.name: Gordon Ramsay Hell's Kitchen
listings.blurb: The Beef Wellington is chef's kiss — get a reservation, trust me.
listings.description: The Vegas location is worth the wait. Red vs. Blue kitchen theatrics and a Beef Wellington that lives up to the show.
listings.tam_quote: Yes, the Vegas location is worth the wait. Beef Wellington is chef's kiss. Get a reservation, trust me.

listings.name: Carbone
listings.blurb: Old-school Italian-American glam — the spicy rigatoni is non-negotiable.
listings.description: Tableside Caesar, spicy rigatoni vodka, and a room that feels like 1960s New York. Reservations drop 30 days out and vanish fast.

listings.name: Prohibition Lounge
listings.blurb: Enter through the bookcase. Password: "Lucky 7." 1920s cocktail recipes.
listings.description: Enter through the bookcase. Cocktails built from 1920s recipes, a jazz trio most nights, and a strict no-photos policy that keeps it magic.

listings.name: The NoMad Bar
listings.blurb: Hidden behind a library wall — the best cocktail bar in LA, hands down.
listings.description: Tucked behind a library wall downtown. Order the Death & Co collab menu and settle in. The best cocktail bar in Los Angeles.
listings.tam_quote: Hidden behind a library wall. Order the Death & Co collab menu. The best cocktail bar in Los Angeles, hands down.

listings.name: The Vault Speakeasy
listings.blurb: Downtown Fremont's secret — $8 prohibition cocktails and a hidden menu.
listings.description: Step through the old bank vault door on Fremont. Prohibition-era cocktails, a secret menu, and one of Downtown's best-kept secrets.

listings.name: The Prohibition Bar
listings.blurb: A hidden gem behind an unmarked door in the heart of LA.
listings.description: No sign, no marquee — just an unmarked door and a doorman who knows the password. Vintage cocktails and a crowd that keeps the location quiet.

listings.name: Cirque du Soleil — O
listings.blurb: The aquatic masterpiece at Bellagio. Bucket list, without question.
listings.description: Cirque's aquatic masterpiece performed in and above a 1.5-million-gallon pool at Bellagio. Bucket list, without question.

listings.name: Absinthe
listings.blurb: Raunchy, hilarious, jaw-dropping acrobatics in an intimate spiegeltent.
listings.description: Part circus, part comedy roast, all adults-only chaos in an intimate spiegeltent at Caesars. You'll laugh and gasp in equal measure.

listings.name: Pinstripes
listings.blurb: Bocce, bowling, and bottomless brunch — girls' day or date night done right.
listings.description: Bocce ball, bowling, and bottomless brunch under one roof. Delivers for a fun girls' day or a low-key date night.
listings.tam_quote: Bocce ball, bowling, and bottomless brunch? This place absolutely DELIVERS for a fun girls' day or date night.

listings.name: AREA15
listings.blurb: Immersive art, Meow Wolf, zip lines and neon everything.
listings.description: An immersive playground of art installations, Meow Wolf's Omega Mart, ax throwing, and a full bar. Unlike anything else in Vegas.

listings.name: Ghostbar at Palms
listings.blurb: $10 signature drinks and 55th-floor skyline views.
listings.description: Perched on the 55th floor of the Palms with a glass floor and 360° skyline views. Signature cocktails and the best sunset seat in the valley.

listings.name: Golden Nugget Casino
listings.blurb: Gulf Coast gaming on the beach with sunset views and shrimp po'boys.
listings.description: Beachfront gaming on the Mississippi Gulf Coast. Classic casino floor, a killer pool, and shrimp po'boys steps from the sand.

listings.name: Harrah's New Orleans
listings.blurb: Steps from the French Quarter — jazz, gumbo, and 24/7 tables.
listings.description: A block from the French Quarter with round-the-clock tables, a lively slot floor, and easy access to Bourbon Street after your session.

listings.name: Commander's Palace
listings.blurb: Turtle soup, 25-cent martinis at lunch, and Creole royalty since 1893.
listings.description: A Garden District institution since 1893. Turtle soup, bread pudding soufflé, and legendary 25-cent martinis at lunch.

listings.name: Peppermill Fireside Lounge
listings.blurb: A retro fire-pit lounge that's pure old-Vegas romance.
listings.description: A sunken fire pit, tufted booths, and towering cocktails. This retro lounge has been serving old-Vegas romance since 1972.

listings.name: Top Golf Las Vegas
listings.blurb: Four floors of climate-controlled bays, pools, and party vibes.
listings.description: Four stories of hitting bays, two pools, and a rooftop lounge. Great whether you golf or just want the cabana-and-cocktails scene.

listings.name: The Chandelier Bar
listings.blurb: A three-story crystal bar with a secret 'Verbena' off-menu cocktail.
listings.description: Three levels wrapped in two million crystals inside the Cosmopolitan. Ask upstairs for the off-menu Verbena — it makes your tongue tingle.

road_trips.name: Las Vegas, NV
road_trips.blurb: The ultimate casino weekend. 30+ casinos, world-class dining, shows nightly.

road_trips.name: Atlantic City, NJ
road_trips.blurb: Boardwalk casinos, fresh seafood, and a classic East Coast vibe.

road_trips.name: New Orleans, LA
road_trips.blurb: Jazz, gumbo, Bourbon Street, and riverboat casinos. Pure magic.

road_trips.name: Reno, NV
road_trips.blurb: The Biggest Little City. Underrated casinos, hot springs, and Tahoe nearby.

road_trips.name: Nashville, TN
road_trips.blurb: Honky tonks, hidden speakeasies, rooftop bars, and an incredible food scene.

road_trips.name: Biloxi, MS
road_trips.blurb: Gulf Coast casinos on the beach. Shrimp po'boys and sunset views.
